environment.browser: local Playwright Chromium for existing match-detail smoke test
environment.external_requests: none initiated by salary slice; existing browser test blocks non-local requests
environment.score_generation_or_model_work: none; salary factor score_effect is NONE

acceptance.profile_input: Only the explicit preferences.salary_expectations leaf is added to the job_match task scope; parent preference containers and unrelated leaves are denied.
acceptance.salary_comparison: Compare closed interval overlap only when profile text explicitly states USD or uses the dollar symbol with annual period and complete finite bounds, and the posting has complete finite nonnegative annual USD bounds from employer/source-provided data. Mixed k-suffix ranges are left UNKNOWN because shared scale cannot safely be inferred.
acceptance.status_rules: Overlapping or touching closed intervals are ALIGNS; disjoint intervals are NO_DIRECT_MATCH; incomplete, one-sided, mixed-scale, estimated, nonannual, ambiguous, non-USD, or mismatched inputs are UNKNOWN.
acceptance.privacy: Explanations and profile-access audit payloads do not echo the salary preference value.
acceptance.score: No score weight or penalty was added.
acceptance.connected_flow: Synthetic profile API save/read, deterministic match recomputation, job detail API read, and reopened SQLite match readback verified. Existing match-detail display renders the fit_factors collection generically.

checks.observed: 40 tests; explicit annual USD overlap, disjoint and touching endpoints, one-sided and missing bounds, ambiguous/nonannual/mismatched/estimated currency cases, score neutrality, API save/read, recomputation, durable readback, least-data scope, denied preference access, audit value-redaction, and existing agent task compatibility
TypeScript check and Vite production build; reused existing local node_modules through a temporary worktree junction, then removed the junction

1 local connected Chromium match-detail/reload test; the user with an overlapping annual USD preference sees Salary expectation — ALIGNS, the other profile sees UNKNOWN, reload persists the selected profile and detail, and no external requests occur.

red_first_reproduction.observed: The added USD 90-110k annually expectation against posting bounds 80000-89000 falsely returned ALIGNS instead of UNKNOWN because the shared parser scaled only the endpoint with k.

local_review.findings: Salary explanation is generic and value-free; all recognized salary statuses carry score_effect NONE; only the exact profile salary leaf was added to job_match scope; no scoring weight or external action changed.

limitations: This is one bounded explainable-match factor; MJ-REQ-114 remains PARTIAL.
